text.tspan: Up to 3 picks, marked in their rows:
top 3 by score, no AI label
a beam that turns every 5 s
random set of 7 at full opacity
Clock runs: every 1.6 s the next
source of the queue comes (up to 10)
(helper2 news · N line, Show all in place)
> new this week N | coming up N
While a list scrolls by: its head
(and column names or tabs) stays under
the pinned box until the list ends
pointer over it, focus in it, tapped,
Every 5 s one row leaves at the top,
the next comes in at the bottom
